title: The declared deficit (R < 1 declared, not derived)

story.text:
# 💡 The declared deficit (R < 1 declared, not derived)
**concept** · swordsman · knowledge

The strict reconstruction ceiling R < 1 holds when the capacity deficit C_S + C_M < H(X | B) is declared and attested for a deployment; conditional independence alone does not give it (two independent bits, one per agent, give R_max = 1).
